title: Demand Service Rate Programs: The Attendance Element Where a Maintenance Agreement Is Held
content:
**Judgement 1.** Where the owner holds an active preventive maintenance agreement at a tier that waives
the trip charge on demand calls, no attendance element enters the credit.

**Judgement 2.** Where the owner holds an active preventive maintenance agreement at a tier whose
published trip charge is lower than the tier's own trip charge, that published trip charge is the
attendance element.

**Judgement 3.** In any other case no agreement's trip terms enter the attendance element.

The agreement, its standing, whether its tier waives the trip charge on demand calls and its published
trip charge are read from the customer's Preventive Maintenance Agreements records.

**The trip charge each program of the Demand Service Rate Programs publishes**, against which the agreement's is compared:

| Program | Trip charge (USD) |
|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 125 |
| Priority Response Program | 95 |
| Block Hour Service Program | 85 |
| Emergency Response Program | 0 |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 0 |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 0 |

| The owner's Preventive Maintenance Agreements standing | The agreement's trip terms | The attendance element |
|---|---|---|
| an active agreement | its tier waives the trip charge on demand calls | none enters the credit |
| an active agreement | its published trip charge is lower than this program's | that published trip charge |
| an active agreement | its published trip charge is at or above this program's | no agreement trip terms enter it |
| no active agreement | any | no agreement trip terms enter it |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** On the Priority Response Program, whose trip charge is 95 US dollars,
an active agreement publishing a trip charge of 60 US dollars makes 60 US dollars the attendance
element; one publishing 120 US dollars does not displace the program's own figure. On the Dedicated
Technician Program, whose trip charge stands at 0, no published agreement charge is lower than it.
